products.name: Meenakari Dabba
products.description:
Meena Kari dabbas are multi-purpose — ideal for storing dry fruits, sweets, snacks, mukhwas, spices, or small household items — and often feature a snug lid to keep contents fresh and secure. Their durable stainless steel construction ensures long-lasting use and easy cleaning, while the colorful enamel details make them perfect as gifts for weddings, festivals, housewarmings, or special occasions . Whether used as practical storage or decorative accents, Meena Kari dabbas uniquely blend artistry with everyday functionality, celebrating traditional Indian craftsmanship in a contemporary home.
